content.text: {v.win and 'D002 — YOU WIN!' or 'D002 — Push crates to goals'}
Arrows move  Enter reset  B back

scripts.init:
local v = ctx.v
v.win = false
-- Board setup: W = Wall, G = Goal, C = Crate, P = Player, . = Floor
v.w = 7
v.h = 6
v.grid = {
    'W','W','W','W','W','W','W',
    'W','G','G','.','.','W','W',
    'W','W','W','.','C','.','W',
    'W','.','.','C','P','.','W',
    'W','W','W','W','W','W','W',
    'W','W','W','W','W','W','W'
}
v.goals = { {1, 1}, {2, 1} }

-- Find player
for i, cell in ipairs(v.grid) do
    if cell == 'P' then
        v.px = (i - 1) % v.w
        v.py = math.floor((i - 1) / v.w)
        v.grid[i] = '.'
        break
    end
end

local function redraw()
    local lines = {}
    for y = 0, v.h - 1 do
        local row = ""
        for x = 0, v.w - 1 do
            local cell = v.grid[y * v.w + x + 1]
            if x == v.px and y == v.py then
                row = row .. "@"
            elseif cell == 'W' then
                row = row .. "#"
            elseif cell == 'C' then
                row = row .. "O"
            elseif cell == 'G' then
                row = row .. "."
            else
                row = row .. " "
            end
        end
        table.insert(lines, row)
    end
    v.boardText = table.concat(lines, "\n")
end
v.redraw = redraw
v.redraw()
scripts.move:
local v = ctx.v
local nx = v.px + v.dx
local ny = v.py + v.dy

local function getAt(x, y)
    if x < 0 or x >= v.w or y < 0 or y >= v.h then return 'W' end
    return v.grid[y * v.w + x + 1]
end

local function setAt(x, y, val)
    v.grid[y * v.w + x + 1] = val
end

local dest = getAt(nx, ny)
if dest == '.' or dest == 'G' then
    v.px = nx
    v.py = ny
elseif dest == 'C' then
    local nnx = nx + v.dx
    local nny = ny + v.dy
    local beyond = getAt(nnx, nny)
    if beyond == '.' or beyond == 'G' then
        -- Push crate
        setAt(nx, ny, '.')
        -- restore goal if we moved a crate off it
        for _, g in ipairs(v.goals) do
            if g[1] == nx and g[2] == ny then
                setAt(nx, ny, 'G')
            end
        end
        setAt(nnx, nny, 'C')
        v.px = nx
        v.py = ny
    end
end

-- Check win
local won = true
for _, g in ipairs(v.goals) do
    if getAt(g[1], g[2]) ~= 'C' then
        won = false
        break
    end
end
v.win = won

v.redraw()
